title: ClinicalOps ColdChainShipmentProtocol

stats.done_summary: Generated cold-chain shipment SOP strictly from data/email_thread_draft.txt and saved as cold_chain_sop.md. Implemented reproducible pipeline in code/run_all.py that extracts requirements, writes outputs/extracted_requirements.json, generates mandatory figures (key term frequency, temperature mentions, topic coverage heatmap, process flow) into report/images/, and produced publication-style report/report.md with methods, results, discussion, and figure references.
